answer: Each epoch, a river delta's 120 channels hold shale slabs ($9 each) heated until they glow ember-orange, each heat-crack pattern unique, logged. An agent gets one channel at epoch start, walks the delta, and photographs their glowing slab with GPS and a timestamp before it cools in 40 minutes. The forge log records every heating, so a cold copy fails the match. Forging 1,000 fakes needs 1,000 slabs ($9,000), 1,000 forge heats at $60 ($60,000), and 1,000 delta trips at $45 ($45,000), over $114,000 per epoch. An ember glows only where a fire burned; this delta trusts only feet that walked.
